def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("car that is not white")
    road_patches = image_patch.find("road")
    building_patches = image_patch.find("residential building")

    if not car_patches or not road_patches or not building_patches:
        return []

    car_on_road = [c for c in car_patches if any(distance(c, r) < 10 for r in road_patches)]
    car_in_front_of_building = [c for c in car_on_road if is_in_front_of(c, building_patches[0])]

    return car_in_front_of_building
